notes.title: It’s time to talk! On the Road to 1.8.0
notes.content: [p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2665680/discussions/0/572641938358959719/" style="button"]CLICK HERE TO LEAVE FEEDBACK[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate you being such a passionate community.[/p][p]Since our Early Access launch back in May 2025, we’ve already reached version 1.7.0.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, we are focused on two big priorities:[/p][p]• Rolling out new content and systems from our public roadmap[/p][p]• Continuously working on quality-of-life (QoL) improvements[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback has helped us make a lot of progress and we’ve been able to keep adding new content along the way. We know there are still areas that need work.[/p][p]The ones we hear most often are:[/p][p]• Fatigue from repetitive farming and item grinding[/p][p]• Low gold income compared to the high costs at Altar of Blessings[/p][p]• The need for rune/jewel removal[/p][p]• Characters looking too similar and lacking unique identities[/p][p]• Plus other issues that might not be as common but are still important[/p][p][/p][p]Some of these haven’t been solved yet, as we’re taking the time to make sure fixes keep the game balanced and fun for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Many of these issues will be addressed in the upcoming 1.8.0 update.[/p][p](Distinct character identities are part of the new “Hearth of Souls” system on the roadmap.)[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we’d like to hear from you. Share your thoughts and suggestions here. We’ll be reading and reflecting them in future updates.[/p][p]A couple of quick notes:[/p][p]1. There may be a lot of posts, so we might not reply to every single one[/p][p]2. We’ve got players from all over the world. Feel free to post in your native language, but please know that we'll be replying in English.[/p][p]3. Please keep it respectful. Profanity and abusive language may get removed or left unanswered.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all the support you’ve shown toward Tower of Babel. You’re what keeps us building this world.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2665680/discussions/0/572641938358959719/" style="button"]CLICK HERE TO LEAVE FEEDBACK[/url][/p]

notes.title: RE-CORE UPDATE 1.5.0 — We Rebuilt the Core
notes.content: [h3]RE-CORE UPDATE 1.5.0[/h3][p][/p][p]Early Access already brought you shared gold, magnet auto-pickup, an effect-opacity slider, double STASH space, faster Lobby speed—the whole nine yards. But you asked for bigger, deeper changes, so we went back to the studs and rebuilt the core.[/p][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p][b]1. Altar of Blessings Reboot[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blessing Levels didn’t carry over between Heroes, so rolling a new character felt rough[/p][/*][*][p]We split Class-Exclusive and All-Heroes rows; every skill stat is now global[/p][/*][*][p]All your Classes’ skill levels merge into one shared level that powers everyone[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]2. Account-Wide Floor Progress[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Classes no longer slog from Floor 1[/p][/*][*][p]Progress is shared up to your highest cleared Floor, so fresh Heroes jump straight into the fight[/p][/*][*][p]Combined with the Altar overhaul, leveling a new Class is a breeze.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]3. Pick Your Difficulty[/b][/p][list][*][p]Choose Normal, Hard, or Nightmare when you enter a floor[/p][/*][*][p]Cruise on Normal or crank it up for fatter rewards[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]4. Juicier Curse-Tier Loot in the CHAOS DUNGEON[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each higher Curse tier now adds extra Magic Item Find Chance[/p][/*][*][p]Bigger risk, bigger loot—dial in the tier that fits your style[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]5. Blessed Skills Twice as Common[/b][/p][list][*][p]Blessed skills pop up 2× more often mid-run, making it easier to lock in your dream build[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]6. Lobby Speed +20%[/b][/p][list][*][p]Movement in the Lobby got a 20 % bump, so it never feels slower than live combat[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the legendary affix [b]\[Phoenix] +1 Resurrection Count[/b] was not applied correctly after acquiring the Phoenix skill.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Highlight Cursor[/b] setting would reset.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p]We built RE-CORE so you can level faster, grow Classes easier, and swim in sweeter loot.[/p][p][/p][p]⸻[/p][p][b]To Our Community[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Digging the changes? Hyped for what’s next? Drop us a quick Steam review![/p][p]Your feedback keeps the roadmap rolling, and we’re hammering away on the next big update.[/p][p]Thanks for being awesome.[/p]

notes.title: 100,000+ Copies Sold – Thank You All!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Survivors,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]What a ride it’s been over the past month.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your incredible support, [i]Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos[/i] has officially sold over [b]100,000 copies[/b] on Steam, just a few days shy of the one-month mark![/p][p][/p][p]To put that into perspective: this is our [b]first-ever PC title[/b]. For our small team at NANOO, reaching this milestone so quickly is both humbling and surreal. We were also featured in Steam’s [b]Top Releases of May 2025 (Bronze tier)[/b], and the game has now passed [b]3,300 reviews[/b], with players averaging nearly [b]25 hours[/b] of playtime. That level of engagement means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]We poured a lot of love into this project, and it’s incredibly rewarding to see so many of you enjoying it. Whether you’ve left a review, shared feedback, or simply played the game for hours, [b]thank you[/b]. Every bit of that helped shape where we are today.[/p][p][/p][p]The idea behind [i]Tower of Babel[/i] was simple: what if we combined the loot-heavy progression of [i]Diablo[/i] with the chaotic, swarm-filled survival of [i]Vampire Survivors[/i]?[/p][p]From the looks of it, many of you were in need of that exact experience.[/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the beginning.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re [b]currently in Early Access[/b], and we’ve got a full roadmap ahead: free content updates, balance patches, and quality-of-life improvements, all shaped by your feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts. You’re helping us make the game better for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]For us, [i]Tower of Babel[/i] represents years of building games, learning from mistakes, and finally taking the leap into the PC space. It was a big step, but the overwhelming response from this community has made it worth every moment.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re committed to continuing this journey with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again.[/p][p][/p][p]— Tower of Babel Dev Team (NANOO)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158330/3ddf38956e82bc743cc5846284f716aa4202b0eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158330/73f57c34167a1cd67d1bcd9983cf51c411e72b21.jpg"][/img][/p]
